supplied_requirements.envelope: Maximum diameter 38.0 mm; overall height 18.0 mm including 2.0 mm front hub.
supplied_requirements.grip: Six equally spaced shallow scallops; minimum grip diameter >=33.0 mm; nominal 1.0 mm exposed-edge rounds; subtle raised dots without glove catches.
supplied_requirements.socket: Concentric blind D socket, 10.0 mm deep, based on 6.00 mm round boundary and 5.20 mm flat-to-far-round shaft, with 0.20 mm radial and 0.20 mm flat clearance.
supplied_requirements.socket_wall: Material above socket >=3.0 mm; no insert, set screw, taper or keyway.
supplied_requirements.manufacturing: PETG; P1S; 0.4 mm nozzle; 0.20 mm layers; four walls; 35% infill; installed matching profiles required.
supplied_requirements.tolerance: Proposed non-mating tolerance +/-0.25 mm; socket design values remain separate from later measurements.
supplied_requirements.review_scope: Human review of socket interpretation, orientation, supports and exact final package; no physical-printer transfer or print start.
supplied_requirements.use_assumptions: 0.15 N m hand torque and 0–35 C ambient are unvalidated intended-use assumptions.

scallops.profile: Subtract six circular arcs of radius 8.00 from the 38.00 mm diameter body profile; cutter centers lie on radius 24.75.
scallops.phase: Scallop centers at 0, 60, 120, 180, 240 and 300 degrees about +X.

hub.placement: Concentric on front face, spanning z=16.00 to z=18.00.

dots.placement: Two per lobe on the front body face at radius 13.50; lobe centers are 30+60n degrees and dots are offset +/-8 degrees from each lobe center.

rounds.treatment: R1.00 on front and rear scalloped perimeter edges, hub top rim and hub root; dots remain smoothly domed. Socket boundary is excluded as a mating feature.

socket.construction: In socket-local XY, retain the portion of the radius-3.20 circle satisfying x>=-2.40. The shaft flat derives from 3.00-5.20=-2.20, then moves outward by 0.20; the round radius derives from 3.00+0.20.
socket.placement: Concentric; opens at rear plane z=0 and extends toward the front to z=10.00.

proposed_geometry.orientation: Model coordinates place the rear/socket opening at z=0 and front hub at positive z. Proposed print orientation rotates the part so the socket opening faces upward and the front hub faces the build plate; support outcome remains subject to slicer inspection.

basis_review: Approve the circular-arc scallop profile, 2.25 mm depth, 33.50 mm minimum grip and stated phase.
Approve 12.00 x 2.00 mm hub, twelve 1.20 x 0.35 mm dots and their placement.
Approve exposed-edge treatment and exclusion of the mating socket boundary.
Approve the D-boundary derivation, flat direction, 5.60 mm cleared flat-to-far-round span and rear-to-front blind-depth direction.
Approve socket-up orientation intent before geometry generation.
remaining_verification: Inspect generated geometry for envelope, wall thickness, rounds, manifold condition and correspondence to the approved basis.
Evaluate actual slicer orientation, required supports and support/slicing preview, especially front-hub build-plate contact and socket preservation.
Verify distinct source and repaired meshes, repaired-mesh revision binding, installed P1S/PETG profiles and final 3MF settings.
Verify package contents, digests and local simulated-transfer receipt; do not dispatch to a physical printer.
Measure and test later artifacts for fit, dimensions, strength and print outcome; none is established by this proposal.
